art_direction: 细长开口正视，下线极短、上弧略不齐，留白宽横，平短眉。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two slender open eyes with fine, slightly uneven upper arcs and very short lower strokes. Both broad pupils face forward and almost fill the openings. Reserve a wide horizontal paper gap inside each pupil, one with a small slanted end. Keep the corners curved, not pointed like drawn eyeliner. Let a little flat iris remain at the sides. Use two small straight brow marks with unequal lengths. The paired gaze is steady and unhurried. Center it on paper without a mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
